mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS effects; tolterodine may increase pramipexole levels via CYP2D6 inhibition, and combined anticholinergic activity increases adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased pramipexole side effects (dizziness, hallucinations, orthostatic hypotension) and anticholinergic symptoms; consider dose adjustment or alternative antimuscarinic if adverse effects emerge.
